chapter_title: Concerning the living Fire: It is present in Eight Places.
chapter_note: Dominantly CORE: a systematic enumerative teaching locating the living fire in eight cosmic stations (Light Land, Father, First Man/Perfect Man, the two light ships, Living Spirit’s descent gear, new earth foundations, and an eschatological manifestation). Only the opening dialogue attribution (“the apostle speaks”) is later FRAME wrapping; the rest stays cosmos→cosmos with no institutional or NT overlay.

paragraphs.core_text: The [holy] living f[ire] is present i[n] eight places.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue/frame attribution: "Once again the apostle speaks:" (Layer-2 hagiographic container; rule 12).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Opening is a formulaic dialogue attribution using “apostle” (FRAME marker), followed by a bare thesis statement that initiates the systematic eight-place scheme (CORE).

paragraphs.core_text: The first place wherein it is, is this [light] land [where it is present and] exists. It is established beneath [it ... ut]terly beyond the totality. It is the foundation and ba]sis of that great earth, and the consideratio[n th]at is beneath them all.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Impersonal structural voice; cosmic topography (“light land… beyond the totality”) and degree/foundation language; stays entirely within the cosmological system.

paragraphs.core_text: The second place wherein it is, is the Father, the God of truth; because [the Fathe]r is established in his great, mighty consideration. So, [firs]t in the Father. The other powers that came from him were revealed through him, and (the fire) too came w[i]th them [and was revea]led by them.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic placement within divine hypostasis; emanation language (“powers that came from him”) and “consideration” as an internal cosmological attribute—no citation or application.

paragraphs.core_text: The third [place wherein it is], is the First Man, h[e] wh[o ... ... ] armour. Again, it is this fire [ ... ... ] on the body of the Perfect Man.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic being→body/armour correspondence (fire as swathing/armour); still purely cosmological enumeration.

paragraphs.core_text: [The fourth is this fir]e that was purified from all the [light] powers, [which is i]n the outer wall, in the ship of the day.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Purification mechanics and placement in the “ship of the day” (sun-vehicle) are classic core cosmography; no institutional pointer.

paragraphs.core_text: [The fifth i]s this fire that is in the light-giver of the night [ ... ] within the water.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Parallel station to ¶5 (night-ship/moon), continuing the numbered cosmological list.

paragraphs.core_text: [The] sixth is this f[i]re that is purified from the totality. The Living [Spirit] swathed it upon his body, over the summons and the obedience. He has established many things by it. He went down and stripped himself of it before the Por[t]er.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Process-description (purified; swathed; went down; stripped) within the mythic-cosmic system (Living Spirit, Summons/Obedience, Porter). No audience address or polemic.

paragraphs.core_text: The seventh is this living fire that is of the new earth, and is the consideration. For it is the first foundation in the new earth, it they built anew [ ... ... ] the first course, that is a crown for the entire earth. T[hey] are below the totality, over the entire earth of da[rkne]ss [ ... ] in it, in the [ ... ] whole [ ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Degree/foundation architecture (“first foundation… first course… crown”) mapping fire↔consideration within the ‘new earth’ cosmology; remains internal to the system.

paragraphs.core_text: [The] eigh[th] is the fire that shall be revealed in this [ ... ... ] person, and it signifies fear and war. Furthermore it [ ... ] it displays and manifests its sign in [its ter]ror. It shall be r[ev]ealed in these two light ships.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Eschatological/cosmic revelation still framed as a property/sign-function of the fire and its manifestation in the two light ships; no NT citation, no institutional application.

paragraphs.core_text: This i[s the way] that the holy living fire exists in these [eight places].
paragraphs.temporal_note: Closing summary sentence that simply seals the enumerative teaching; not a hagiographic doxology or community instruction, so it reads as part of the original schematic exposition.
